curiosities: CDTV stands for Commodore Dynamic Total Vision.
It is essentially an Amiga 500 with a CD-ROM drive, sold as a living-room multimedia player.
It came with a wireless infrared remote control.
Discs go in a caddy, as in early CD-ROM drives.
With a keyboard, mouse and floppy drive added, it works as an Amiga.
It sold poorly, and the CD32 replaced it.
Its processor is a 68000 at about 7 MHz, with 1 MB of memory.
